property_summary: For any account and token id, before any mint/burn activity the balance reported by c.balanceOf is the stored balance, which is initially 0 (the mutant wrongly returns the id itself), so for any fresh account and nonzero id the correct contract returns 0 while the buggy one returns id.
change_summary: Return the id instead of the stored balance, changing the return value for calls with nonzero ids.
